snippet.title: This Cozy Cat Adventure Is Coming To Nintendo Switch! | Catto's Post Office
snippet.description:
Catto's Post Office, the beloved cozy game that launched on Steam this summer, is coming soon to Nintendo Switch!
Buy now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2908050/Cattos_Post_Office/

Deliver mail as Catto, the town's dedicated Postcat, while meeting unique friends in a cozy cat-themed town filled with cute kitty residents. Explore the charming open world at your own pace, indulge your cat-like instincts (with boxes to hide in, objects to knock over, and a dedicated button to meow whenever you like), and get to the tail-end of a most purr-culiar mystery: today's your birthday and everyone seems to have forgotten?! Oh my whiskers…

About the developers
In Shambles Studio was formed through their united love for cats and creating games. They wanted to make a short and cozy game for everyone to enjoy in their downtime and thought, 'who doesn't love cats?' As a result, they poured their hearts into creating their first title, Catto's Post Office.
